reviews.result:
I found no confirmed correctness regressions on the paths that ship today. There is one latent issue that the trainer origin-map branch will expose, and two places where the tests don't cover the real wiring. Per your instructions I wrote no files (including the plan file plan mode asks for) and used no subagents.

## What checks out

- **Native behaviour:** `ScrCmd_CreateCameraTarget` (`src/scrcmd_c.c:1438-1451`) becomes `world.ts:83-87`. It places the target at the tile centre, gives it the terrain height, points streaming at it, and the camera follows it. There's no sprite or save data. `RemoveCameraTarget` (`scrcmd_c.c:1453-1461`) clears the target, and `draw` (`world.ts:208`) smoothly pans back to the player.
- **Free camera:** yaw, pitch and distance are never changed, and the tests check this (`script-camera.test.ts:79-80,87`).
- **241 lookup:** `script.ts:65` checks for 241 before the normal NPC lookup, matching `Script_GetMapObjectByPerson` (`scrcmd_c.c:1203-1205`).
- **Map156 script2:** it pans 5 tiles north, then 5 south, and ends with Remove (`scr_seq_0018_D15R0103.s:29-56`). It contains no battle or warp, and the music CallStds are skipped at `script.ts:164`.
- **Cancellation:**
  - Each `move()` call is tied to one target and its generation counter (`script-camera.ts:24-28`). A Clear, a new Create, or a field change stops it from writing any further positions.
  - When the VM finishes, it clears the target before waiting on pending moves (`script.ts:178`). A cancelled 241 move goes into `movementFailure` and isn't re-thrown from `finally`.
  - `enter` always clears the target (`world.ts:94`); `connect` clears it when the header changes (`world.ts:109`).
- **Streaming:** `updateStreaming` uses the target's position only when it's on the same map (`world.ts:117`). The frame loop skips streaming during transitions (`main.ts:211`). Keeping cells near the target rather than the player (`world.ts:162`) matches native `MapLoadManager_TrackTarget`.
- **Other actors and the error path:** moves for non-camera actors are unchanged (`main.ts:43-59`). The target is already cleared when the error message appears (`main.ts:85`).

## Integration requirement (latent, not a regression)

**The camera target is tied to the script's map instead of the map the player is on.**
- `script.ts:98` passes the script's own map. `main.ts:201` forwards `target.map.id`, and `world.ts:84` throws unless that equals `activeHeader`.
- `script-camera.ts:25` then refuses to move 241 unless the movement script's `map.id` matches the map the target was created on.
- Native code uses `fieldSystem->location->mapId` (`scrcmd_c.c:1443`), and 241 resolves no matter which script it's in.
- **Today:** this already breaks inside `CallStd` child VMs, which run with the common script bank as their map (`script.ts:48`). It only matters if a common script uses 241, and I couldn't confirm one in this snapshot.
- **With the trainer origin-map branch:** any 241 script running with an origin map different from the active header will throw "inactive source field" or "Missing original camera movement object 241".
- **Fix:**
  - Have the main hook create the target on `world.activeHeader` (or `state.map`), not `target.map.id`.
  - Have `ScriptCameraTarget.move` use the passed map only to look up the movement label.
  - Replace the `actor.map!==map.id` check with a check against the field map stored at create time.

**Failure-recovery branch:** any recovery path that abandons or replaces a running VM without its `run()` finishing (so `finally` never runs), or resets the field without `world.enter`, must call `world.clearScriptCameraTarget()`. Otherwise the camera and streaming stay on a stale target. A recovery that re-enters the field through `enterMap` is already covered by `world.ts:94`.

## Test gaps

1. **The real wiring is never exercised.** The tests write their own `cameraTarget`/`move` hooks (`script-camera.test.ts:26-28`), so `main.ts:42` (routing moves to the camera target) and the `cameraTarget` hook at `main.ts:201` aren't tested. The latent issue above would show up in exactly that wiring.
2. **No VM-level test of a field change during a 241 move.** The cancellation test (`script-camera.test.ts:59-66`) runs against `ScriptCameraTarget` directly. Nothing tests the VM case where `world.enter` clears the target while a 241 `ApplyMovement` is pending. That test should check that `run` rejects with the cancellation error, `busy` ends false, and the target stays null.

Browser QA is still pending, as you noted. I didn't run the tests; the 25 passes are as you reported.

I've finished reading all the changed files. I found nothing that needs fixing. I wrote no files, including the plan file plan mode asks for, ran no commands and used no subagents.

## What I checked

- **The camera target now belongs to the live field.** The hook in `main.ts:202` passes `state.map` instead of the script's own map (`setScriptCameraTarget` at `script-camera.ts:13-15`). `createScriptCameraTarget` (`world.ts:83-87`) still requires that id to match `activeHeader`. Both are set inside `enterMap` or `world.enter`/`connect` before any script can start. This matches native `fieldSystem->location->mapId` (`scrcmd_c.c:1443`).
- **The script's bank only supplies movement labels.** `ScriptCameraTarget.move` (`script-camera.ts:32-55`) no longer compares the bank's map id. The field check moved to `world.ts:90`, which compares the target's stored field with `activeHeader`. So a common bank with id 999 routes correctly, and the test at `script-camera.test.ts:92-98` covers that.
- **Main and the tests use the same router.** `moveActor` (`main.ts:42`) and both test hooks call `scriptCameraMovement`. An error thrown synchronously at `world.ts:90` still turns into a rejection, because `moveActor` is async. It then reaches `movementFailure` (`script.ts:100`).
- **Cancellation:**
  - The generation and identity checks (`script-camera.ts:36-37,46`) stop a stale tween from writing positions.
  - `enter` clears the target first thing (`world.ts:94`). `connect` clears it when the header changes (`world.ts:109`).
  - `enterMap` clears it before the async `world.map` hydration (`main.ts:91`).
  - The VM's `finally` clears an owned target, then waits for pending moves (`script.ts:178`).
  - The VM test (`script-camera.test.ts:100-108`) checks this in the right order: the run rejects, `busy` ends false, and the target stays null.
- **Native lookup:** 241 is resolved before the NPC lookup (`script.ts:65`), matching `scrcmd_c.c:1203-1205`. Remove clears the target and the camera goes back to the player, matching `scrcmd_c.c:1453-1461`.
- **Streaming:**
  - Streaming follows the target only when it's on the same field (`world.ts:117`).
  - Creating a target re-streams around it (`world.ts:86`).
  - The frame loop skips streaming while `transitioning` (`main.ts:212`).
  - After a clear, the next frame streams around the player again.
- **Free camera:** nothing writes yaw, pitch or distance, and the tests assert this (`script-camera.test.ts:80-81,88`).
- **Error path:** the target is cleared in the VM's `finally` before `runScript` shows the error message (`main.ts:85`).

The trainer and lift branches are separate integration work, not regressions here, as you said. Browser QA is still pending. I didn't run the tests, so the 27 passes are as you reported.
